Class BenchmarkResultFactory

java.lang.Object
grafioschtrader.reportviews.performance.BenchmarkResultFactory
public final class BenchmarkResultFactory extends Object
Builds the comparison of a valuation series with its benchmark: the time-weighted comparison with its relative risk, the shadow portfolio, the chart and the notices. The period performance report and the historical replay both build their result here, so they agree on every figure for the same input and differ only in the settings their own series call for.

  • Method Details

    • build

      public static BenchmarkResultFactory.Built build(BenchmarkDescriptor descriptor, BenchmarkSeries.Result aligned, ReturnSeries series, List<ReturnSeries.ValuationPoint> points, List<MoneyWeightedReturn.DatedFlow> flows, LocalDate requestedFrom, LocalDate requestedTo, BenchmarkResultFactory.Settings settings)
      Builds the comparison.
      Parameters:
      descriptor - identity, conversion and return basis of the benchmark
      aligned - the benchmark aligned on the valuation dates, null when it could not be loaded
      series - the time-weighted series of the valuation points, null without valuations
      points - the valuation points with their flows
      flows - the dated external flows for the money-weighted return of the shadow portfolio
      requestedFrom - first date the caller asked for
      requestedTo - last date the caller asked for
      settings - convention, annualization and risk-free rate of the caller
      Returns:
      the result, with the identity and the notices even when no comparison could be formed
